package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(request.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(request, "id"))
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusCreated, item)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) ListPracticeTaskFinalReviews(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	items, err := handler.Students.ListPracticeTaskFinalReviews(request.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(request, "id"))
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": items})
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) ListPendingPracticeTaskFinalReviews(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if _, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context()); !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	limit := parseReviewQueryInt(request, "limit", 50)
	offset := parseReviewQueryInt(request, "offset", 0)
	items, err := handler.Students.ListPendingPracticeTaskFinalReviews(request.Context(), limit, offset)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": items})
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) GetPracticeTaskFinalReviewForReviewer(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if _, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context()); !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.GetPracticeTaskFinalReviewForReviewer(
		request.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(request, "id"),
		chi.URLParam(request, "reviewID"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) ReviewPracticeTaskFinalSubmission(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	reviewerID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	var payload struct {
		Passed   bool     `json:"passed"`
		Score    *float64 `json:"score"`
		Feedback *string  `json:"feedback"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.ReviewPracticeTaskFinalSubmission(
		request.Context(),
		reviewerID,
		chi.URLParam(request, "id"),
		chi.URLParam(request, "reviewID"),
		studentuc.PracticeTaskMentorDecision{
			Passed:   payload.Passed,
			Score:    payload.Score,
			Feedback: payload.Feedback,
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) RetryPracticeTaskAIReview(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if _, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context()); !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.RetryPracticeTaskAIReview(
		request.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(request, "id"),
		chi.URLParam(request, "reviewID"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func parseReviewQueryInt(request *http.Request, key string, fallback int) int {
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(request.URL.Query().Get(key))
	if err != nil {
		return fallback
	}
	return value
}
